tools.name: explore_designs
tools.description: Lists 8B site designs: the look, the structure and the kinds of business each one suits. Use it to choose the design for the user's site.

tools.name: get_design_brief
tools.description: Returns the brief for writing the site in a design: every text with a hint and max length, the color palette, fonts and photos. Write them for the user's business and pass the values to generate_site.

tools.name: generate_site
tools.description: Generates the user's site with 8B from a design and the texts, colors, fonts and photo queries written for the business, and shows a live, animated preview in the conversation. Call get_design_brief first to see the fields. Returns the preview id, the preview link and the link to download the site.
